test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

This is __on far a best__ ice cream I have ever had.
solution:
The correct answer is **by far the best.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence is by far the best.

 
 
• 
 
The proposition **On** is used when something touches something else.

 
 
• 
 
The preposition **By** is used for is used to specify who or what is performing the action or how it is performed.

 
 
•
